title: Cataloging Cuttlefish
statement: Hovering through a sun-dappled tank of swaying eelgrass, mossy terracotta shards, and smooth sea-glass pebbles, this pocket-sized cuttlefish ripples shimmering Morse-code stripes across its skin as it inspects every corner of its tiny world. It spends its days fluttering its ribbon-like fins to arrange empty shells and sunken marbles into neat little rows, pausing only to flash a delighted neon polka-dot whenever a pattern feels just right.
